maxWidth.$description: Maximum width for a snackbar surface.

background.$description: Fallback snackbar surface used when the snackbar is rendered outside the inverse color scope. In normal use the snackbar reads --semantic-color-surface-page inside its own .a1-inverse scope, so the surface flips: dark on a light document, light on a dark document.

border.$description: Fallback snackbar border, matched to the fallback surface.

foreground.$description: Fallback snackbar text used when rendered outside the inverse scope.
